    \caption{Decoder coverage, conditional accuracy and full-profile recovery, evaluated over the benchmark instance set under synthetic finite-shot sampling (data source SYN-N12c). Coverage is the $K$-independent geometric erasure count, 252 of 264 steps feasible. Conditional accuracy is shown for single-trial and trial-median decoding, and full-profile recovery is plotted against shot budget $K$, with 95\% bootstrap intervals throughout. The ratio-1 imputation variant is drawn as its own clearly separated curve. Steps whose dial feasibility window is empty are recorded as erasures and excluded from conditional accuracy, and erased steps stay erased. The figure supports the benchmark-specific decoder claim - estimation followed by constrained decoding over a controlled hypothesis class with maximum degeneracy two. It does not establish readability below the visibility floor, decoding beyond the tested hypothesis class, or performance on instances outside the benchmark family.}
